suttas.title: Himavantasutta
rows: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, himavantaṁ pabbatarājānaṁ nissāya nāgā kāyaṁ vaḍḍhenti, balaṁ gāhenti;
himavantaṃ bhikkhave, pabbatarājānaṃ nissāya nāgā kāyaṃ vaḍḍhenti balaṃ gāhenti.

suttas.title: Ayonisomanasikārasutta
rows: “Ayoniso, bhikkhave, manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando uppajjati, uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṁvattati; anuppanno ceva byāpādo uppajjati, uppanno ca byāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṁvattati; anuppannañceva thinamiddhaṁ uppajjati, uppannañca thinamiddhaṁ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṁvattati; anuppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccaṁ uppajjati, uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccaṁ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṁvattati; anuppannā ceva vicikicchā uppajjati, uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṁvattatī”ti.

ayoniso bhikkhave, manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando uppajjati, uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati. anuppanno ceva vyāpādo uppajjati, uppanno ca vyāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati. anuppannañceva thinamiddhaṃ uppajjati, uppannañca thinamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati. anuppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati, uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati. anuppannā ceva vicikicchā uppajjati, uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatīti.

‘‘Ayoniso, bhikkhave, manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando uppajjati, uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati; anuppanno ceva byāpādo uppajjati, uppanno ca byāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati; anuppannañceva thinamiddhaṃ uppajjati, uppannañca thinamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati; anuppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati, uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati; anuppannā ceva vicikicchā uppajjati, uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatī’’ti.

ayoniso bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando uppajjati uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati. anuppanno ceva byāpādo uppajjati uppanno ca byāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati. anuppannañceva thīnamiddhaṃ uppajjati uppannañca thīnamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati. anuppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati. anuppannā ceva vicikicchā uppajjati uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati.

“Yoniso ca kho, bhikkhave, manasikaroto anuppanno ceva satisambojjhaṅgo uppajjati, uppanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchati …pe… anuppanno ceva upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo uppajjati, uppanno ca upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchatī”ti.

yoniso ca bhikkhave, manasikaroto anuppanno ceva satisambojjhaṅgo uppajjati; uppanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati …pe… anuppanno ceva upekhāsambojjhaṅgo uppajjati; uppanno ca upekhāsambojjhaṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchatīti.

yoniso ca kho bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppanno ceva satisambojjhaṅgo uppajjati uppanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati …pe… anuppanno ceva upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo uppajjati uppanno ca upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchatīti.

kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro.
Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro?
upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṁ bhāveti vivekanissitaṁ virāganissitaṁ nirodhanissitaṁ vossaggapariṇāmiṁ …
upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ…pe…
evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro”ti.
evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu sattabojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāroti.
evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro’’ti.

suttas.title: Tathāgatādisutta
rows: “Yāvatā, bhikkhave, sattā apadā vā dvipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā”ti vitthāretabbaṁ.
yāvatā bhikkhave, sattā apadā vā dvipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā …pe… bahulīkarotīti. (bojjhaṅgavasena dasa suttantāni vitthāretabbāni)
‘‘Yāvatā, bhikkhave, sattā apadā vā dvipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vāti vitthāretabbaṃ.
yāvatā bhikkhave sattā apādā vā dvipādā vā catuppādā vā bahuppādā vāti vitthāretabbaṃ.
(appamādavaggo bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttassa bojjhaṅgavasena vitthāretabbo). bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttassa appamādavaggo dasamo.

suttas.title: Balādisutta
rows: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci balakaraṇīyā kammantā karīyan”ti vitthāretabbaṁ.
seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci balakaraṇīyā kammantā kārīyanti …pe… bahulīkarotīti. (bojjhaṅgavasena dvādasasuttā vitthāretabbā).
‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci balakaraṇīyā kammantā karīyanti…pe….
seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci balakaraṇīyā kammantā kayirantīti vitthāretabbaṃ.

suttas.title: Esanādisutta
rows: kāmesanā, bhavesanā, brahmacariyesanā …pe… bhāvetabboti. (maggasaṃyuttassa esanāvaggo viya vitthāretabbo)
(bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttassa esanāpeyyālaṃ vivekanissitato vidūhi vitthāretabbaṃ). esanāvaggo dvādasamo.

suttas.title: Uddhambhāgiyasutta
rows: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṁ uddhambhāgiyānaṁ saṁyojanānaṁ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvetabbā.
Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvetabbā.
imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvetabbā.
Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṁ bhāveti vivekanissitaṁ virāganissitaṁ nirodhanissitaṁ vossaggapariṇāmiṁ …pe…
Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ…pe…
idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ …pe…
Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcannaṁ uddhambhāgiyānaṁ saṁyojanānaṁ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ime satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvetabbā”ti.
Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ime satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvetabbā’’ti.
imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ime satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvetabbāti.
khandhā uddhambhāgiyānīti. oghavaggo terasamo. cha pācīnato ninnā cha ninnā ca samuddato dve te cha dvādasa honti vaggo tena pavuccati. (bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttassa gaṅgāpeyyālaṃ rāgavasena vitthāretabbaṃ).

suttas.title: Punatathāgatādisutta
rows: rukkhakumbhena sukiyā ākāsena ca dve meghā nāvā āgantukā nadī.

suttas.title: Punaoghādisutta
rows: bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttassa esanāvaggo sattarasamo. ogho yogo upādānaṃ ganthā anusayena ca kāmaguṇā nīvaraṇā khandhā uddhambhāgiyānīti. (rāgavinayapariyosānadosavinayapariyosānamohavinayapariyosānavasena oghavaggo vitthāretabbo). aṭṭhārasamo.
bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ samattaṃ. tatra vagguddānaṃ: pabbato gilānudāyī nīvaraṇo cakkavatti
bojjhaṅgo vānāpāno ca nirodhagaṅgāpeyyālo appamādo balakaraṇīyo esanoghā punādihi gaṅgāpeyyāla ādīhi pañcahaṭṭhāraseva teti.
